header: What we've shipped and what comes next
lead: We update this list on the first working day of each month. Items appear only once they are designed, and we never remove one without saying so.
note: Dates are targets, not commitments. If something misses its quarter, we mark it as late instead of moving it silently.

items.title: Shift marketplace between branches
items.text: Staff can now offer a shift to colleagues at any site their contract covers.

items.title: Offline clock-in on iOS
items.text: Clock-ins are signed and stored on the device, then sent when the connection returns.

items.title: Qualification expiry warnings
items.text: 30 days' notice to the holder and their manager.

items.title: Budget forecasting by season
items.text: In beta at eight sites. General release is expected in the third quarter.

items.title: Works council reporting pack
items.text: Regular reports on overtime, night work and short-notice changes.

items.title: Payroll connector for Kontura
items.text: Waiting for their API v3, which is announced for the autumn.
